sermon.title: Overcoming Discouragement
sermon.speaker: Blake Fambrough
sermon.summary: Guest speaker Blake Fambrough teaches from Numbers 21, where Israel grew discouraged and God told Moses to lift up a bronze serpent. Discouragement is born when we force fruit out of season; it steals clarity and motivation and even touched John the Baptist. Its door is prayerlessness; the answer is to look up to Jesus, pray and share your gifts.

faqs.question: Who is Blake Fambrough?
faqs.answer: He introduces himself as the assistant principal at Mountainside Academy.

faqs.question: Can God make up for lost time?
faqs.answer: He’s not too late; everything God promised in your life He can double up in one day.

faqs.question: Why do we need aggression now?
faqs.answer: Discouragement causes loss of inspiration, motivation and aggression, and we need aggression to fight this coronavirus.

faqs.question: What happened to King David?
faqs.answer: He stopped praying, and that is when discouragement entered.

faqs.question: This time we won’t make it?
